sentences.text: Since these appeals are arising out a common accident and common judgment & award, they are clubbed together and decided by common judgment.
3. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to by their rank before the Tribunal.

4. It is the case of the petitioners that on 01.11.2015 at 7-30 p.m., deceased Satyam, Mahesh and Lakhan Rathod were proceeding on motorcycle bearing registration No.MH-13/BW-0649 (for short 'motorcycle').
While Satyam was riding the motorcycle, Mahesh and Lakhan Rathod were pillion riders.
They were proceeding towards Tuljapur.

On Solapur-Tuljapur road, near Jigajeni Petrol pump of Hagalur village, a HCV bearing registration No.MH-06/AL-4581 (for short, 'offending vehicle), came from opposite side, in a high speed, in a rash or negligent manner dashed against the motorcycle while trying to overtake another vehicle.
Due to the impact, all of them sustained grievous injuries.
Satyam died on the spot.
Mahesh and Lakhan Rathod died on their way to the hospital.
Petitioners were dependent on the deceased.
As the owner and insurer of the offending vehicle, respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation.

5. Respondent Nos.1 and 2 filed separate written statement denying the age, occupation, income of the deceased and also the fact that accident occurred due to the rash or negligent driving of the offending vehicle.
Since it is a case of triple riding, accident occurred due to the negligence of the rider of the motorcycle.

Respondent No.2 has contended that as the driver of the offending vehicle was not holding a valid driving licence, respondent No.2 is not liable to pay the compensation.
6.
Based on these pleadings, the Tribunal has framed necessary issues.
7. Common evidence was led in respect of three petitions by examining P.W.1 to 4 and Exs.P1 to 10 are marked on behalf of the petitioners.
8. No oral evidence is led on behalf of respondents, but copy of the insurance policy is marked as Ex.R.1.

9. Vide the impugned judgment and award the Tribunal has partly allowed the petitions and granted compensation as detailed below:
